name: aade-mydata
description: Read AADE myDATA e-books, propose and send expense classifications (E3/VAT), and reconcile myDATA with ERP or bank exports. Test environment by default.

mydata_user_id.title: myDATA username
mydata_user_id.description: Your myDATA REST API username (aade-user-id). Test and production registrations have different usernames.

mydata_subscription_key.title: myDATA subscription key
mydata_subscription_key.description: The subscription key (Κωδικός API) for that username. Stored in your system's secure credential store, never in settings files or the chat.

mydata_env.title: Environment
mydata_env.description: Which myDATA environment these credentials belong to. Writing to prod still needs your explicit approval and --yes-production.
